var html = String(result);
if (html == null) { html = ''; }
if (html.length < 500) { try { html = String(java.ajax(baseUrl)); } catch (e) { html = ''; } }
var base = String(baseUrl);
if (base.charAt(base.length - 1) !== '/') { base = base.replace(/[^\/]*$/, ''); }
var re = /<a[^>]+href="(\d+)\.html"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/g;
var m; var arr = [];
while ((m = re.exec(html)) !== null) {
  var nm = m[2].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  if (nm.length > 0) { arr.push({i: parseInt(m[1], 10), name: nm, url: base + m[1] + '.html'}); }
}
arr.sort(function (a, b) { return a.i - b.i; });
var out = [];
for (var k = 0; k < arr.length; k++) { out.push({name: arr[k].name, url: arr[k].url}); }
JSON.stringify(out)
</js>
